items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: He wrote "Crazy Cat" and "Three Blind Mice" in collaboration with Trumbauer.

ctx.x: "I'm More Than Satisfied","Three Blind Mice", Corinda and that was with Bix, Don Murray, Trumbauer, Arthur Schutte,Carl Kress on guitar. I think you were a friend of Carl Kress.

items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Also you wrote "Three Blind Mice". Was that with Frankie Trumbauer. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Okay. What about some of the others? I asked you about Bix. How about Frankie Trumbauer? What do you remember of him? Was he the same way? Was he very much like Bix?
You were very close with Frankie Trumbauer.
